==Trivia==
This event is called "SELL_DRONES_STATION" in the datafiles.
* Note that the scrap rewards for selling drone parts are affected by the Scrap Recovery Arm and Repair Arm augments - you could get more or less scrap as a result. <span style="color:grey;">[Repair Arm needs verification]</span>
